summary: Iteration 4: Tested workflow-based comment builder (auto-seed on create, mark-shipped, mark-delayed endpoints + UI). All 12 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend flow verified end-to-end on Flange 2000 client — auto-seed comment renders correctly ('02.09 - Planned ETD 25.11.'), Delayed button opens Calendar Popover and appends 'Vessel delayed slightly. Now planned ETD 20.09.', Shipped button appends 'SOB 15.09. Awaiting ANF.', all in a single row's comments after picking a date.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 918 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (clients, shipments, reports) for maintainability.

The delayed snippet 'Vessel delayed slightly. Now planned ETD 20.09.' (from _append_comment) does not itself end with a period before _append_comment; _append_comment adds sep only between existing and snippet, so the final comment may not end with period if snippet doesn't. Not a bug per spec (spec says either is fine), but inconsistent with SOB snippet which does end in period.
_fmt_dot_date is defined after being used inside create_shipment (works at runtime due to Python late binding but reads oddly).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_iter4_client client created and torn down by pytest module fixture; UI test created a shipment 'TEST_UI_AutoSeed4' under Flange 2000 and deleted it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints: POST /api/shipments/{id}/mark-shipped {sob_date} and POST /api/shipments/{id}/mark-delayed {new_etd}. Both accept ISO or DD.MM.YYYY. UI buttons: data-testid mark-delayed-{id} (rose) and mark-shipped-{id} (emerald). Calendar day buttons: 'button[name=day]'. All working.
